# NPL Hub Nepal

> Independent information platform for Nepal Premier League (NPL) cricket. Provides verified match fixtures, live scores, points table standings, team profiles, player rosters, and tournament statistics.

## Core Hubs
- [Schedule & Fixtures](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/schedule): Complete 32-match schedule for NPL Season 3 with dates, times in Nepal Time (NPT), Nepali BS calendar dates, and TU Stadium Kirtipur venue information.
- [Points Table](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/points-table): Official team standings, wins, losses, Net Run Rate (NRR), tournament points, and top-4 playoff qualification rules.
- [Teams Directory](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams): Profiles, leadership, captains, head coaches, home regions, and match schedules for all 8 NPL franchises.
- [Players Directory](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/players): Verified index of confirmed squad members, marquee leaders, auction signings, and overseas cricketers across all teams.
- [Statistics & Records](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/stats): Historical Season 2 (2025) records and Season 3 (2026) statistics including top run-scorers and leading wicket-takers.
- [News & Tournament Updates](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/news): Editorial coverage, squad developments, tournament format announcements, and cricket insights.

## Franchise Teams
- [Biratnagar Kings](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/biratnagar-kings): Koshi Province franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Chitwan Rhinos](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/chitwan-rhinos): Bagmati / Chitwan franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Janakpur Bolts](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/janakpur-bolts): Madhesh Province franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Karnali Yaks](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/karnali-yaks): Karnali Province franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Kathmandu Gurkhas](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/kathmandu-gurkhas): Capital franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Lumbini Lions](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/lumbini-lions): Lumbini Province franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Pokhara Avengers](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/pokhara-avengers): Gandaki Province franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.
- [Sudurpaschim Royals](https://nplhubnepal.vercel.app/teams/sudurpaschim-royals): Far-West Province franchise squad, fixtures, leadership, and stats.

## Tournament Facts
- Tournament Name: Siddhartha Bank Nepal Premier League (NPL) Season 3
- Competition Format: Twenty20 (T20) Cricket
- Governing Body: Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN)
- Primary Venue: Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground (TU Stadium), Kirtipur, Kathmandu, Nepal
- Number of Teams: 8 Franchises
- Total Matches: 32 T20 Matches (28 League Stage + 4 Playoff Fixtures)
